prompts.prompt: I have pages but I am not a website; couples may share me before bed.
I arrive before a trip, hold plans, and often contain too many saved places.
I can be sweet or salty, come in a bowl, and disappear during a movie.
I have two wheels, no engine, and can carry a picnic in a basket.
I am folded on a table, opened on a road trip, and never need a battery.
I glow on a cake, shrink while working, and go out with one breath.
I am a meal outdoors, usually packed in a basket and spread on a blanket.
I capture a moment, fit in a frame, and can make an ordinary day memorable.
I am worn around the neck, useful in winter, and easy for two people to share.
I have pieces, a picture, and a satisfying final gap to fill.
I am a list of songs made for a mood, trip, person, or year.
I carry hot drinks, have a handle, and often wait beside a laptop.
I stretch across water, connect two sides, and can be crossed on foot.
I open above your head, prefer rainy days, and sometimes flip in the wind.
I have a screen, a curtain, and rows of seats facing the same story.
I am a small written message that may hide in a lunch bag or coat pocket.
I show days in boxes and help two people protect time for a date.
I am made of fabric, cover a bed, and can become a living-room fort.
I grow in soil, lean toward light, and may be given as a thoughtful gift.
I am cold, sweet, served in scoops, and risky on a sunny walk.
I have a lens, a shutter, and a habit of appearing on trips.
I carry clothes, have a handle, and become harder to close before vacation.
I can be handwritten, sealed in an envelope, and reread years later.
I mark a trail, protect feet, and often get muddy on an adventure.
I am a public green space with benches, paths, and room for a slow afternoon.
I am a morning meal that can arrive on a tray or become dinner.
I am a tiny paper promise exchanged for entry to a show, ride, or journey.
I reflect faces, reverse movements, and help when getting ready.
I am built over flames, surrounded by seats, and good for stories after dark.
I am a route taken on foot, sometimes scenic, sometimes aimless, often shared.
